scholarships.name: Bilateral Exchange of Academics (to Germany) **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: To improve international relations and bilateral research cooperations between German universities and universities abroad, the DAAD supports the **mutual exchange** of academics. The basis for the exchange are cultural agreements between the Federal Republic of Germany and partner countries as well as bilateral agreements with partner institutions abroad.

scholarships.sourceQuote: The programme is aimed at university teachers and experienced academics and scientists. As a rule, you should have a doctorate and you should be working at a university or research institute in your home country.
